question: Can any smarter validation re-scoring of the s049 cascade pool (tol/K sweep, continuous-score rank, bright epochs, per-q_a rank) concentrate mass on truth?
hypothesis: A better validation strategy can lift truth-q_a enrichment above the random baseline and make the cascade a usable seed generator.
narrative_md: Closes path B: across 100+ validation re-scorings (tol/K, continuous-score top-N, bright-epoch augmentation, per-q_a ranking) no filter exceeds random by a meaningful margin -- max enrichment 5.98x is one survivor in 155, and truth-q_a's best per-q_a score ranks 516-958 of 1113 (bottom half). Mechanism: at 17% omega-noise, drift produces surrogate-mag errors comparable to random hypotheses, so mag-agreement carries no separable truth signal. Phase 3 (omega-noise reduction) is mandatory. Reads truth-q_a enrichment throughout.
